page.overview:
Who is Kalandra?

Kalandra was the science officer on board the in 2373.

His wife was a Federation physician in charge of a battlefield hospital on Ajilon Prime during the 2373 Klingon invasion. That year, when Julian Bashir mentioned that the Tecumseh and the were heading up the fleet involved in a counterattack, Dr. Kalandra mentioned her husband was serving on the Tecumseh, prompting Bashir to reassure her that the ship's commanding officer Captain Raymond had gotten the ship through the Cardassian Wars and wouldn't lose it now. ()
